Status: the Phase 118 implementation is not on disk yet, so the diff-pass cannot run as specified.

- TFL-1248 depends on [TFL-1247](/TFL/issues/TFL-1247) (qa G), whose terminal blocker is [TFL-1242](/TFL/issues/TFL-1242) (frontend-dev B). Chunks C-F have produced no code: no app file imports `src/renderer/intake/`, and `useOsIntegration.ts`, `Welcome.tsx`, `CreateFromImagesDialog.tsx` are unmodified. The drop-routing / clipboard / Home / Create-from-images entry points this task names do not exist to attack.

What I could attack (the only Phase 118 code present - chunk B `src/renderer/intake/model.ts`), via a plain-Node probe (no vitest / build / e2e: a build mutex owned by qa for TFL-1273 was held):

- ADV-251 (MEDIUM): a mid-dispatch Remove silently skips the next queued file. `dispatch` iterates the live queue across the `openPdf` await (`model.ts:223`) and the tray keeps Remove enabled.
- ADV-252 (MEDIUM): two dispatches during one slow PDF open build the images PDF twice. Image items stay `ready` until after the PDF loop (`model.ts:246-247`) and `dispatch` has no in-flight guard.

Held: no extension-only trust / no bogus "Ready"; duplicate basenames disambiguated and order preserved; synthetic pathless `File` does not crash; Remove is queue-only; no parallel store / IO / network.

Both findings are recorded in `ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.md` with `Disposition: PENDING`. Probe: `test-fixtures/tfl1248-adversary/probe-intake-dispatch.mjs` (log alongside), left uncommitted for git-agent.

Unblock: frontend-dev finishes chunks B-F ([TFL-1242](/TFL/issues/TFL-1242)..[TFL-1246](/TFL/issues/TFL-1246)) and qa completes G ([TFL-1247](/TFL/issues/TFL-1247)); then H can run the running-app diff-pass on the real merges.
